sources.title: insraq/MiniCPM5-2B-heretic-abliterated · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We are releasing MiniCPM5-2B, the second model in the MiniCPM5series, following MiniCPM5-1B. It is a dense 2B Transformer that scales up the same training recipe, built for on-device, local deployment, and resource-constrained scenarios, reaching 2B-class open-source SOTA.

sources.title: OpenBMB releases MiniCPM5-2B | Artificial Analysis
sources.snippet: OpenBMB is the open-source AI group behind the MiniCPM series of efficient small models. MiniCPM5-2B is a 2.6B parameter dense reasoning model with text input and output, released under Apache 2.0.
